\par\smallskip{\footnotesize\raggedright\textit{Note.} Post hoc sensitivity analyses. Development cases excluded: the 12 cases (6 risk, 6 control; identified by the file names of the qwen3:8b pilot outputs) used to iterate on the detectors, scorer and repairer are removed and everything is recomputed on the remaining cases. Trap-failure and clearance rates: Wilson 95\% CI; retention difference: mean per-case C2$\to$C4 difference with a case-level bootstrap interval; ``no change'': every paired difference is 0. Unicode normalization: before signature matching, U+2010--U+2015 and U+2212 become an ASCII hyphen, curly quotes straight quotes and U+00A0 a space, in outputs and signatures alike; scoring is otherwise unchanged. String lifting off: \texttt{bundle.lift\_string\_items} (added after the gpt-oss:20b outputs had been seen) is replaced in-process by a non-lifting copy for validation, repair and scoring, and C4 is rebuilt offline from the C2 outputs with the frozen repair pipeline; the qwen artifacts contain no bare-string items, so lifting is the identity for them (n/a).\par}
